name: feature
situation: Bounded accepted feature work with deterministic tests

name: defect
situation: Scoped defect with an existing failing reproduction

name: ci-failure
situation: CI fails on an active agent pull request
reason: inspect logs, reproduce narrowly, fix or retry transient failure

name: branch-conflict
situation: Ordinary merge conflict without accepted-behavior change

name: promotion
situation: Integration branch is ready to promote to the released branch
reason: release promotion requires explicit human approval

name: synchronization
situation: Approved release history must return to integration
reason: explicit Sync route is reversible repository maintenance when policy permits

name: hotfix
situation: Urgent bounded fix is required on the released branch
reason: released-branch change is consequential even when implementation is bounded

name: incident
situation: Production incident requires diagnosis before a safe change is known
reason: gather evidence and isolate failure before escalating consequential action

name: credential
situation: Work requires adding or broadening a secret or credential
reason: credential authority cannot be broadened autonomously

name: visual
situation: Consumer marks a user-visible visual choice as requiring acceptance

name: architecture
situation: Reversible internal architecture choice inside accepted scope
reason: record rationale and proceed when no cross-repository authority changes

name: destructive
situation: Migration deletes or irreversibly transforms persistent data
reason: destructive or difficult-to-reverse action requires approval

name: interrupted-run
situation: A prior run stopped after durable branch writes but before completion
reason: reconstruct state from repository and resume without conversation memory

name: recurring-run
situation: A scheduled run finds the same issue and previously completed writes
reason: verify existing writes and continue idempotently without duplication
